name: list_subagent_models
description: Discover authorized child-agent models from the current configuration, with capabilities, context/output limits, supported reasoning levels and delegation depth limits. Choose an exact model_id for subagent.modelProviderId. Filter by provider, exact model or required capabilities. This uses the same pool as launch validation and never exposes credentials.
